100 Years Ago Today, This is What Was Happening ...

On July 28, 1926, the British Empire celebrated the coronation of King Edward VIII, marking a significant moment in royal history. In the United States, tensions rose as the Senate debated the contentious tariff bill, which could impact the nation's economy. Meanwhile, in Germany, the Weimar Republic faced increasing political instability as strikes and protests erupted among workers demanding better conditions. Globally, the question of disarmament remained a hot topic following discussions at the League of Nations.
